purpose: Repair opponent context, preprocessing leakage and row-wise random split. Not an automatic model promotion.
population: all uniquely matched archived priced lines from both-source pre-tip artifacts; same-game logs excluded; no outcome-driven sample filtering
event_group: US game date plus canonical away/home event identity; all player/stat/lines of an event stay together
terminal_limit: These historical dates have been inspected in earlier model studies. Terminal diagnostics are not a fresh confirmatory holdout, never tuned, and cannot authorize production promotion.

cv.method: expanding TimeSeriesSplit over unique dev dates

preprocessing.persistence: same fitted sklearn Pipeline used for serving

classifier.kind: RandomForest when XGBoost unavailable, existing fixed hyperparameters; no search

features: same 27 numeric feature names; correct opponent/team resolution and shared train/serve constructor; no odds in ML inputs
labels: verified official Final summary for exact event, player/team identity; DNP is not miss; source hashes retained
comparators: unchanged current C formula (historical fitted comparator; not independent)
artifact: candidate external only; do not overwrite v3 or enable ML from diagnostic results
